reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch explain that Caleb alone is named because he spoke first, even though Joshua stood beside him and later joined the appeal to the people.

sides.snippet: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
sides.verseText: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
